BYLAWS OF CEDAR GROVE SQUADRON 9

Article I. Meetings
Regular meetings shall be held on the second Tuesday of each month at 7:00 p.m. at the Post home.

Article II. Opening
Opening ceremonies shall include the Pledge of Allegiance, an opening prayer, and a moment of silence for POW/MIA.

Article III. Order of Business
The order of business shall be: opening ceremonies, roll call, reading of minutes, reports, old business, new business, good of the order, and adjournment.

Article IV. Officers
The officers of this Squadron shall be a Commander, a 1st Vice Commander, a 2nd Vice Commander, an Adjutant, a Finance Officer, a Chaplain, a Sergeant-at-Arms, and a Historian.

Article V. Quorum
A quorum shall consist of the Commander or a Vice Commander and three other officers.
